_about: Cue name -> exact spoken phrase (a verbatim, unambiguous substring of the RECORDED narration as transcribed in transcript.json). tools/word_anchors.py resolves each to a real transcript word time so the builder anchors the matching composition cue to audio, never to an assumed words-per-second. Phrases avoid hyphenated compound tokens (just-in-time, always-on, time-box) that ASR may split. `beat_*` entries are scene boundaries: each scene in scenes.json starts on the first spoken word of its narration slice, so a scene's cues are simply `A.<cue> - A.<beat>`.
_lead_in: 3.0 - narration.wav is mounted at t=3.0 so the silent brand bumper plays first.
